select prp.id,pp.product_name,prp.product_type_upgraded,psc.customer_name,DATE_FORMAT(prp.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime,SUM(prp.reservoir_rate) AS reservoirRate,SUM(prp.total_payment_rate) AS totalPaymentRate from pr_reservoir_project prp inner join pr_super_customer psc ON prp.superCustomer_Id=psc.id inner join pr_product pp ON prp.product_id=pp.id
GROUP BY prp.id Limit #{start},#{size}
select count(*) from pr_reservoir_project prp inner join pr_super_customer psc ON prp.superCustomer_Id=psc.id inner join pr_product pp ON prp.product_id=pp.id

SELECT SUM(prp.reservoir_rate) AS reservoirRate, SUM(prp.agreement_rate) AS agreementRate from pr_reservoir_project prp inner join pr_super_customer psc ON prp.superCustomer_Id=psc.id inner join pr_product pp ON prp.product_id=pp.id
